dcterms:description: A dataset containing images of handwritten digits, each image is of size 28×28 pixels and contains only one digit. The dataset is used for matching tasks where images of the same digits are considered.
dcterms:title: MNIST Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset containing images from 101 categories, where images are divided into two sets based on the coverage of the object in the image. The dataset is used for experiments involving object matching and registration.
dcterms:title: Caltech-101 Dataset

dcterms:description: A synthetic dataset developed for medical image registration, consisting of ultrasound (US) images simulated from CT images. The dataset is used for registration tasks between US and CT images.
dcterms:title: US-CT Dataset
